adjudication_rationale: Documentation clears the derived-HIGH gate. The store does what ADR-0016 :1233-1236 already says (a changed location is a removal and an install); the defect was nondisclosure. The trigger is narrower than reported: the ADR 'Baseline rule' (:1242-1245) writes no ledger rows for the first full section, so a fresh database (the supported start) writes no pairs and only a database carried across this change does. Once documented the pair is recognisable (a remove and an install, same device, facet, name and version, one observed_at), so I3 'the caller cannot tell' no longer holds and I8 noise remains: once per Mac, pruned with the ledger after 400 days (software_inventory_store.hpp:742). Alternatives were worse (dropping the mapping reverses Alex's 'existing columns' decision; server-side pairing is out of scope). Residual, mitigated not removed: on a carried database the pairs are written, carry no cause label and stay until retention removes them. The run report's 'the ledger has no prune' and 'permanent' were false and no text says so.
